Home ／ Builds ／ Jarvan IV

Jarvan IV

Support Weird but works

Engage Support Jarvan

How to play this build

Your signature combo is Flag (E) + Dragon Strike (Q) for a guaranteed knock-up that starts the fight. Use the ult (Cataclysm) to isolate and cage the enemy carry with your ADC ready to finish.

Skill order

Max priority:

Q Estocada de Dragón → E Estandarte de Comando → W Escudo Dorado

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Dragon Strike (Q) for damage and the EQ knock-up; E second. As support, W (shield) stays at 1 point.

Items and what they do

  1. Sightstone Support item granting free ward charges to control vision.
  2. Iceborn Gauntlet Armor, mana and CDR; after a spell, your attack deals AoE damage and slows (upgraded Sheen).
  3. Randuin's Omen Health and armor; active AoE slow that also cuts attackers' attack speed.
  4. Mercury's Treads Boots with MR and tenacity (reduced CC duration).
  5. Sunfire Cape Health and armor; aura that constantly burns nearby enemies.

Runes

In Season 3, runes were a system SEPARATE from masteries: bought with IP (Influence Points) and slotted into 4 tiers — Marks (red), Seals (yellow), Glyphs (blue) and Quintessences (purple, the strongest). They gave flat stats: damage, armor, penetration, etc.

Marks (red) Armor ×9
Seals (yellow) Health per level ×9
Glyphs (blue) Magic resist per level ×9
Quintessences (purple) Flat health ×3

Armor, MR/level, health quints

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
0/9/21 — Defense/Utility
Why this page
0/9/21 gives durability and utility: you engage and peel, your team provides the damage.
